policy: Voice profiles for narrated reels (tools/reel-maker/README.md -> Voiceover). A profile names a provider, model, voice and settings; it never carries educational content. Story specs select one with narration.voiceProfile. The licence, permitted use and the AI-voice disclosure line live once, on the profile's libraryAsset in audio_library.json. Adding a provider or voice means adding a profile and an asset, not changing audio.py or generate-reel.js.

qualification.scope: This provider, model, preset voice and default settings; English narration; the reviewed spoken-form workflow (scientific terms, chemical formulas, units and numbers in spoken form). Not a permanent or universal voice choice.
qualification.evidence: PrayogX Media Lab controlled tests (outside this repository): tests/voice/elevenlabs/ (English narration, word-for-word transcription gate) and tests/voice/scientific-pronunciation/ (spoken-form science); owner listening review 2026-10-03. Licence: tools/reel-maker/licences/higgsfield-elevenlabs-voice.md.
qualification.alsoQualified: text2speech_v2 (variant elevenlabs) with the same voice passed the same tests; not configured here.

verification.method: local transcription with whisper.cpp, compared word for word with the reviewed spoken form
verification.rule: missing, added, substituted, repeated or reordered words fail; transcriber spellings only through a reviewed equivalence table; low word probability is flagged for listening, not failed

prayogx-en-emily-v1.notes: The provider receives only the reviewed spoken form. Generation is a separate, explicitly authorised step under a per-run credit cap; building a reel never generates audio.
